name: AY
description: Emulator of the General Instrument AY-3-8910 / Yamaha YM2149 sound chip — three pulse oscillators plus a noise oscillator, as found in the ZX Spectrum 128, Atari ST, MSX and other 8-bit machines. Always has DC offset; pair with LeakDC. Tone period is an integer (frequency = clock / 16 / period); use AY.freqtotone to convert from Hz. Provided via the libayemu library wrapped as a UGen. From sc3-plugins AYUGens.

inputs.name: tonea
inputs.description: Tone period of oscillator A (12-bit integer; lower = higher pitch). Use AY.freqtotone to convert from Hz

inputs.name: control
inputs.description: Mixer control byte. Low 3 bits enable the three tone channels (0=on); next 3 bits enable noise mixing onto each channel

inputs.name: vola
inputs.description: Volume of oscillator A (0..15); bit 4 (16) selects envelope-controlled volume

inputs.name: volb
inputs.description: Volume of oscillator B (0..15); bit 4 selects envelope mode

inputs.name: volc
inputs.description: Volume of oscillator C (0..15); bit 4 selects envelope mode

inputs.name: envfreq
inputs.description: Envelope period (16-bit integer; smaller = faster envelope)

inputs.name: envstyle
inputs.description: Envelope shape (0..15) — selects from the chip's hardware envelope shapes

inputs.name: chiptype
inputs.description: Chip flavour: 0 = AY-3-8910, 1 = YM2149 (different envelope step granularity)
